question: Why does Krishna speak the most secret teaching again?
premises: The certain knowledge here is most secret.
Krishna speaks again because Arjuna is dear.
The speech is for Arjuna's benefit.
inference: The most secret teaching is given out of affection and benefit.
uncertainties: Fused editorial phrases included as tokens.
plain_english: Hear again my supreme word, most secret of all; because you are dear to me, I will speak what is beneficial.
